verdict.rationale: Beamer's evidence covers an API, webhooks, third-party integrations (e.g., HubSpot sync), and embedding Beamer's widget into the customer's own app. None of it shows a developer framework or app/extension surface for building custom integrations that render and run inside Beamer's own interface. The embeddable widget runs in the customer's app, which is the opposite direction, and API/webhooks are only building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build custom integrations that appear and operate directly inside the product's own interface
